Ravi (CSM): Heads-up 3 HelioTech flagged renewal risk 5. Usage for 'assist' and 'batch-embed' flows dropped ~55% starting Mon morning. New procurement contact (Tara) started Friday.
Ana (AE): Got it. Any error spikes or SDK regressions?
Ravi (CSM): No errors in our telemetry. Their team turned off a scheduled job last week while they do a side-by-side against OnyxAI.
ops-bot: [signal] account=HelioTech severity=medium reason=seat_activity_drop pct=55 token_drop=true
Marco (Solutions): If they
re freezing jobs, likely lower KV/cache warmups. We should offer a short Dedicated trial with a warmed cache baseline to show steady-state economics.
Tara (HelioTech): hi all 5. Sorry for the surprise. We
re re-evaluating infra after our ML lead left. Procurement asked for an apples-to-apples bakeoff: raw latency, steady throughput, and a short doc on data handling.
Ana (AE): Thanks Tara. Can you share the evaluation criteria (latency threshold, cost per 1M tokens, and data residency)?
Tara (HelioTech): latency target: p95 < 220ms; cost target: total infra + tokens < $0.60 per 1k tokens. We need EU residency for production but trial can be us-west. Also want a short SOC-type blurb.
Marco (Solutions): We'll prepare: 1) a 10-pt perf run (cold vs warm), 2) throughput test at steady-state (100 rps), 3) costs breakdown incl. batching and cache effects, 4) short security note (data retention 7 days, KMS support, audit logs). Sample config we'll propose:
```
mode: dedicated_trial
model: rw-compat-3-large
quant: int8
cache: prefix_kv:enabled
warmup: scripted_prompts
region: us-west-2
metrics: token_cost, p50/p95/p99, throughput
```
Ravi (CSM): Playbook suggestion: quick intro call to align scope (owner: Ana), send trial proposal + perf plan (owner: Marco), offer one enablement session for their infra team (owner: Ravi). Deadline: materials to Tara by Wed EOD.
Ana (AE): I'll set a 30m call. Tara, are mornings or afternoons better?
Tara (HelioTech): Afternoons PT work best. Also can you include a short checklist for what we need to run the trial (API keys, sample dataset, test harness)?
Marco (Solutions): Will include test harness (locust + warmup script) and a minimal cost/latency dashboard (Grafana link). We'll also include instructions to pin model and eviction policies for KV cache.
Ravi (CSM): Note: Renewal status set to "watch" until trial finishes. If trial goes well, we can propose a 6-mo Dedicated commit to lock pricing.
Ana (AE): Scheduling call: Thu 2:30pm PT tentatively. Invites in flight.
Tara (HelioTech): Confirmed Thu 2:30. Can you also prepare a one-pager comparing Redwood vs OnyxAI on these three axes: perf, cost, compliance?
Marco (Solutions): On it 5 will include raw numbers from our benchmarks and an explanation of caching behaviour. Also preparing common competitor talking points.
ops-bot: [task] deliverables: call invite (Ana), trial proposal (Marco), enablement session (Ravi), competitor one-pager (Marco) due_ts=1746316800
Ravi (CSM): Action items assigned. Please drop artifacts in this thread when ready so I can package for Tara.
Ana (AE): Invite sent + agenda.
Marco (Solutions): Draft perf plan uploaded to thread. Includes scripts and expected metrics.
Tara (HelioTech): received. Appreciate the quick turnaround. We'll have our devs wire up the test harness after the call.
Ravi (CSM): Updating renewal board and tagging this as elevated risk until trial concludes. Will follow up post-call.
Ana (AE): Thanks team 5 we'll aim to show steady-state advantage.
Marco (Solutions): Dropping a short compliance blurb in the thread (data residency, retention, KMS).
Tara (HelioTech): Thanks all 5 looking forward to Thu.
